title: Mercury
summary: Reads the balance of every Mercury account from api.mercury.com, once an hour or as often as its setting says, into Money's accounts, and its last thirty days of transactions into the ledger.
changes: An account Mercury has archived is passed over, so it adds no empty row and no longer uses up the run's reads before a live account's transactions. A row tagged with Mercury's id for an account is taken as that account.
author: BrainDog

grant.label: Key
grant.note: The label of the key in the vault that is sent to Mercury as a bearer token. A label and never the key itself: a plugin that carries a key is refused.

every.label: How often
every.note: How often it asks Mercury for balances and transactions. Mercury allows 100 requests a minute, so once an hour is far inside it.

book.label: Book
book.note: The number of the book in Books that every Mercury account and transaction is filed in, such as 2. Leave it at 0 to file none.
